title: Specified dual comparison of a perfect pairing
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be monoidal closed categories, $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ a functor, $c:FC\simeq C^\prime$, and $h:F\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}(C,1)\simeq\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}(FC,1)$. Define the dual comparison to be $h$ followed by precomposition with $c^{-1}$ in internal Hom. Its inverse is the inverse of this composite isomorphism. This construction does not assert pairing reduction or adjoint compatibility. The constituent notions are [def-sfb-monoidal-category] [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor].

def perfectPairingDualComparison (F : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟) {C : 𝒞} {C' : 𝒟}
    (c : F.obj C ≅ C')
    (h : F.obj ((ihom C).obj (𝟙_ 𝒞)) ≅ (ihom (F.obj C)).obj (𝟙_ 𝒟)) :
    F.obj ((ihom C).obj (𝟙_ 𝒞)) ≅ (ihom C').obj (𝟙_ 𝒟)
